original_question: Josh ya yanke shawarar gwada kasuwancin wani gida. Ya sayi wani gida akan $80,000 sannan ya saka $50,000 dan gyara gidan . Wannan ya ƙara darajar gidan da 150%. Nawa ne ribar da ya samu?
question_template: {name_male, Josh} ya yanke shawarar gwada kasuwancin wani gida. Ya sayi wani gida akan ${num_digit_1, 80,000} sannan ya saka ${num_digit_2, 50,000} dan gyara gidan. Wannan ya ƙara darajar gidan da {num_digit_3, 150}%. Nawa ne ribar da ya samu?
question_solution: new_value = num_digit_1 + (num_digit_1 * num_digit_3 / 100); total_investment = num_digit_1 + num_digit_2; answer = new_value - total_investment
